title: Ensemble machine learning selects DNA methylation panel for mortality risk in HIV
summary: In 1,081 participants from the Veterans Ageing Cohort Study, an ensemble method selected a panel of 393 CpGs trained on 460 and validated on 114 participants. In the 507-participant testing set it predicted high mortality risk with an AUROC of 0.809, with a hazard ratio of 1.79 for high versus low predicted risk. The outcome proxy is the VACS index and the test set is a split of one cohort.
ai_technology: Ensemble machine learning for CpG selection
organization: Yale School of Medicine; Connecticut Veteran Healthcare System

evidence.tested: AUROC and survival comparison of predicted risk groups in a held-out testing set of one cohort.
evidence.unknown: Held-out split of a single cohort; VACS index used as risk measure; full text not reviewed.
